title: situation.s13_emancipation_cabinet_draft.title

citations.at: pp. 20–22; Lincoln’s later conversation as reported by Carpenter. Lincoln expressly could not remember the exact July date; 22 July is a provisional catalogue locator, not established by this recollection.
p. 213; draft first submitted to the cabinet, editorial heading 22 July 1862. This is additional evidence for the dated draft, not a verbatim cabinet minute.

namedOnly: Names of addressees, the subjects of allegations or custody, and prospective appointees identify the dated document’s participants; they do not assert that those people hold a post now. Speakers lists the rostered people whose words or official acts are given. Unrostered document authors need the identities and posts recorded in the index before promotion.
